title: Document Extraction Module for Your SaaS Product
summary: An embeddable extraction service for your SaaS product: schemas per document type, per-tenant fields, confidence and source boxes, a review component and webhooks, running in your cloud.

seo.title: Document Extraction Module for SaaS Products | VipraTech
seo.description: Embeddable OCR and LLM extraction for SaaS products: per-tenant schemas, confidence scores, source highlights, review UI and webhooks, in your cloud.

problem.intro: Many SaaS products ask users to upload documents: invoices in AP software, payslips in HR and lending tools, bills of lading in logistics platforms, contracts in procurement suites. Users then type the same data into forms. Building reliable extraction in-house means handling OCR, layouts, model choice, confidence, review and multi-tenancy, which pulls engineers away from the core product.

pain_points.title: Users still re-type data
pain_points.detail: Without extraction, uploads are just attachments and users fill forms by hand, which slows activation and creates errors.

pain_points.title: Templates that break
pain_points.detail: Template-based OCR fails whenever a new supplier, bank or carrier changes its layout.

pain_points.title: Customers want their own fields
pain_points.detail: Each tenant needs a few custom fields or rules, and hard-coded schemas cannot keep up.

pain_points.title: Cost and data concerns
pain_points.detail: Sending every page to the largest model is expensive, and enterprise customers ask where their documents go.

solution.overview: We build a document extraction service that your product calls through an API. Each document type has a versioned JSON schema, and tenants can add custom fields within limits you set. The pipeline runs OCR with layout detection, classifies the document and extracts fields with a language model, returning each value with a confidence score and a bounding box on the source page. Model routing sends easy pages to cheaper models and hard pages to stronger ones. An embeddable review component lets your users confirm low-confidence fields, and their corrections feed back into evaluation. Results go out by webhook. It runs in your cloud account, with tenant isolation and no training on customer documents.
capabilities: API service with versioned schemas per document type
Per-tenant custom fields and validation rules
Values returned with confidence scores and source bounding boxes
Model routing by page difficulty to control cost
Embeddable review component for low-confidence fields
Evaluation suite tracking accuracy per document type and model version

workflow.title: Receive the upload
workflow.detail: Your product sends the document and tenant ID to the extraction API.

workflow.title: Classify and read
workflow.detail: OCR and layout detection run, and the document type is identified.

workflow.title: Extract to schema
workflow.detail: Fields are extracted to the tenant's schema with confidence scores and bounding boxes.

workflow.title: Validate
workflow.detail: Format checks and tenant rules run, such as totals adding up or dates falling in range.

workflow.title: Review if needed
workflow.detail: Low-confidence or failed fields appear in the embedded review component for the user to confirm.

workflow.title: Deliver and learn
workflow.detail: Results are sent by webhook, and user corrections are stored for evaluation.

faqs.q: Can we white-label the review component?
faqs.a: Yes. It is built to sit inside your product with your styling, so users never leave your app.
We choose per document type based on evaluation results and cost, using hosted providers or self-hosted models. The router lets you change models without changing your API.

faqs.q: How do you handle enterprise customers' data concerns?
faqs.a: The service runs in your cloud account and region, isolates tenants, masks personal data in logs and does not train on customer documents.

Ownership is agreed in the contract, and the usual arrangement is that you own what we build for you. We hand over the service, infrastructure code, schemas and evaluation suite, and can support it after launch.
